evidence.reason: scanPatch is documented to scan the patch including removed lines, but its diff-header parsing only strips a/ or b/. Git’s default C-style quoted paths (e.g. "a/secr\\303\\251t.env") keep the surrounding quotes and escape sequences. The resulting path fails path-regex tests such as /\.env$/, so removed secret content in such a file can bypass the project-rule scan when gitleaks is absent. This is an implementation error in existing intended scanning behavior, not a new requirement.
